basic_details.short_information: Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER) has notified 3 vacancies for Senior Resident posts on an ad-hoc contract basis. Eligible candidates can attend a Walk-In-Interview on 17 October 2026, reporting at 12:00 PM along with complete bio-data and attested copies of relevant certificates in the office of the undersigned, Department of GI Surgery, HPB & Liver Transplantation, PGIMER, Chandigarh, with the walk-in venue details given in the official notification. The required qualification for the post is MS/DNB (General Surgery), and the pay is Level-11 as per 7th CPC. T

age_limit.details: Candidates should not be more than 40 years of age in case of General Category, 43 Years for OBC and 45 years of SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 17 October 2026 at 12:00 PM.
